Bag sizes

Every product needs a different footprint. Here's how our standard sizes break down — all available in kraft, white, or a custom stock.

Small

~8" × 4" × 10"

Compact and gift-ready.

Best for: jewelry, cosmetics, small gifts, accessories

Medium

~10" × 5" × 13"

The everyday retail size.

Best for: apparel, boutique purchases, home goods

Large

~13" × 6" × 15"

Room for bigger or multiple items.

Best for: multi-item orders, footwear, larger gifts

Extra Large

~16" × 6" × 19"

Built for bulk and oversized products.

Best for: events, corporate orders, bulky items

Every size above comes in kraft, white, black, or a custom color — see colors. Need a size we don't list?

Our products

Build a packaging system that fits your brand and your products — mix and match across categories, every item available in multiple colors and finishes.

Shopping Bags

Twisted or flat-handle carrier bags for retail checkout — kraft, white, or black.

Food & Takeaway Bags

Kraft bags, rolls, and pouches sized for bread, produce, sandwiches, and snacks.

Paper Cups

Hot-drink cups in plain, printed, or ripple-wall finishes, with matching lids.

Food Boxes

Pizza boxes, burger boxes, triangle wedge boxes, clamshells, and square boxes.

Takeout Containers

Fry scoops, foldable kraft containers, and leak-resistant takeaway boxes.

Pouches & Spouted Packs

Stand-up pouches and spouted packs for liquids, sauces, and refills.

Not sure which product fits what you're selling? Tell us and we'll recommend a starting point.

Colors & finishes

Every product on this site can be produced in more than one color — pick a standard finish or match it to your own brand.

Left to right: Kraft Brown, Black, White — same bag, three finishes.

Kraft Brown

Natural, recyclable, our most-used base material.

White

Clean canvas for bold print and premium presentation.

Black

Matte, premium finish for higher-end retail and gifting.

Custom Brand Color

Send your brand palette and we'll match ink or stock to it.

Colors can be mixed across a single order — for example, kraft bags with a black logo print.
